answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent’s signing key to an enclave whose remotely attested MRENCLAVE matches approved code; the enclave generates and protects the key in hardware. A VM copy cannot reproduce that hardware-protected identity, so creating additional identities requires additional genuine processor-backed enclave capacity, not merely duplicating virtual machines. Attestation and key-registration policy must be enforced; pearl, tundra, and hollow are labels, not trust evidence.
